For the shop

Before this goes live

  • Confirm 831-224-0759 is the one number customers should call
  • Send the real logo file. The name is set in plain type here until then
  • Say who's on the roster now, with a portrait, bio and handle for each artist, and how Mike's name should read
  • Check the services list, and send the piercing menu and photos
  • Send storefront and inside photos, plus the samurai back piece and other favorites
  • OK the tattoo photos used here, and say if any were done by someone no longer at the shop
  • Send pricing, minimum, age and ID rules, and aftercare in the shop's own words
  • Say if there's a Friday the 13th event on November 13, and if the hiring post is still open
  • Confirm hours, payment methods and accessibility details

Sources: the shop's Instagram profile, @tattoo.art.house, from a screenshot dated November 1, 2026, including its hiring and Friday the 13th posters. The shop's Yelp listing and photos, checked November 1, 2026. Hours also on Roadtrippers.
